ttl = open(GRAPH_TTL).read()
import re
# Find sensor nodes that are points of a Zone_F* and have Air_Temperature_Sensor
# Approach: capture triples manually via regex is messy; instead parse line-based.
zone_sensor_lines = {}
cur = None
for line in ttl.splitlines():
    line=line.strip().rstrip('.')
    if not line: continue
    if line.startswith('@') or ':'): continue
    parts = line.split()
    if len(parts)==3:
        s,p,o = parts
        # sensor of zone
        if p=='https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#isPointOf' and o.startswith('http://buildgraph.org/BG_large_office_2004_0000#Zone_F'):
            if 'Air_Temperature_Sensor' in s:
                zone_sensor_lines.setdefault(o, set()).add(s)
print("zones with zone temp sensor:")
for z,v in zone_sensor_lines.items():
    print(z.split('#')[1], v)
print("total zones", len(zone_sensor_lines))
